title: InferenceJobConfig
description: Configuration for a vLLM batch inference job.

model_path.description: HuggingFace model path or local path to the model

input_data.description: Path to input data file or HuggingFace dataset identifier

output_path.description: Path where inference results will be written

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate per sample

tensor_parallel_size.description: Number of GPUs for tensor parallelism
